scope: Whitelist return fix after cdee4e4: MIUI background-display prerequisite and permission-gated UsageEvents fallback

required_canonical_updates.detail: R13.1a now names MIUI background-display permission and separately authorized usage access for apps without accessibility window events; overview no longer promises return from accessibility permission alone.
The Strict Focus panel must explain all three prerequisites, automatic granting is forbidden, and fallback uses only recent package/type/time metadata.

existing_documents_synchronized: docs/android-focus-updates.md: bounded queries, event freshness, generation cancellation, cooldown and per-origin attempt budgets
docs/manual-regression-checklist.md: positive and negative foreground cases remain unchecked pending actual verification
